instrument: corpus replay: every recorded invalid orko-review report through v0.1.0's and v0.1.1's parse_report
corpus: every *.invalid-*.md under ~/files whose path has a 'reviews' component (private projects; reports are read, never copied)
lens_and_doc: each report's own front matter, so the replay measures finding-level handling, not run binding
pass_rule: for every report: v0.1.0 returns errors; v0.1.1 returns no report-level errors, indexes every '### F-<n> ' heading, and marks as malformed exactly the findings v0.1.0 named in its errors
spot_check: run 2026-10-20-110919, accuracy.invalid-2.md and design.invalid-2.md: 3 malformed each (the spec's evidence run)
